senses.gloss:
उत्तिज् Caus. P. To excite,
stimulate, instigate, stir up,
animate, provoke.

उत्तीर्ण p. p.
1 Landed, crossed,
passed over.
--2 Rescued, delivered.
--3 Released from obligation.
--4 One
who has finished his course of
studies; experienced, clever.

ऊतिः f. [अव्-क्तिन् P. III. 3. 97]
1 Weaving, sewing (fr. वे).
--2
Protection.
--3 Enjoyment.
--4
Sport, play.
--5 Favour, kindness.
[]
--6 Aid, assistance, help.
--7 The
money given to a tailor for sewing.
--8 Wish, desire.
